zh.title: 说明
items: **Peer Agent 0.0.14** 聚焦 Workbench 浏览器与 Goal 预览复核、渠道状态更诚实，以及聊天与文件树的稳定性。
本版提供只读远程任务读路径（远程会话只读、任务监视器、远程媒体查看）。远程控制、设备绑定和远程写入仍未交付。

zh.title: 新功能
items: Workbench 浏览器会话保活：切走 Goal / 文件页时不再把网页从零重载。
图片灯箱：缩放、在访达中显示、复制路径。
Goal 视觉预览复核：关闭路径可走完，不再把预览卡住当作用户等待。
只读远程任务路由：远程会话只读、任务监视器、远程媒体查看。

zh.title: 优化
items: 渠道卡片按组内全部模型汇总状态；不可用标在折叠的模型行上，而不是整条渠道。
文件树显示点文件，只跳过已知垃圾目录。
模型选择器用启动时的渠道列表，不再等后续拉取。
macOS 全屏时给红黄绿按钮留出空间；侧栏、聊天纸面与 Workbench 对齐。

zh.title: 修复
items: 单个模型测失败不再把整条渠道标成「不可用」。
聊天工具调用可写入磁盘，重开后不会丢历史。
流式 thinking 不再把界面卡住；Anthropic `max_tokens` 限制在渠道输出上限内。
Gemini 原生 tool 配对保留；Goal 视觉截图能传进 agent loop。
有截图或任务证据的 Goal intake 不再当纯问答丢掉。

zh.title: CLI（仅命令行）
items: CLI 与 Desktop 共用版本号。实际压缩包以 GitHub Release 资源为准。
请把 CLI 压缩包里的 `peer` 和 `peer-credential-helper` 放在同一目录。

en.title: Notes
items: **Peer Agent 0.0.14** focuses on Workbench Browser and Goal preview review, more honest channel status, and chat / files-tree reliability.
This release includes a read-only remote task path (remote sessions, task monitor, remote media). Remote control, device binding, and remote writes are still not shipping.

en.title: What's New
items: Workbench Browser sessions stay alive when you switch to Goal or Files, instead of reloading the page from scratch.
Image lightbox with zoom, Reveal in Finder, and copy path.
Goal visual preview review can close cleanly; a pending preview is no longer treated as waiting on the user.
Read-only remote task routing: remote sessions, task monitor, and remote media viewing.

en.title: Improvements
items: Channel cards aggregate connection status across every model in the group; unavailable is marked on the collapsed model row, not the whole provider.
The files tree shows hidden files and only skips known junk directories.
The model picker uses the bootstrap channel list instead of waiting on a later fetch.
macOS fullscreen leaves room for the traffic-light buttons; sidebar, chat paper, and Workbench stay aligned.

en.title: Fixes
items: A single failed model no longer paints the whole channel unavailable.
Chat tool calls persist to disk, so history survives a restart.
Streaming thinking no longer freezes the UI; Anthropic `max_tokens` is clamped to the channel output ceiling.
Gemini native tool pairing is preserved, and Goal visual captures reach the agent loop.
Goal intake that already captured screenshots or task evidence is no longer dropped as plain Q&A.

en.title: CLI (command-line only)
items: CLI and Desktop share the version number. Consult the actual GitHub Release assets for archive availability.
Keep `peer` and `peer-credential-helper` from the CLI archive in the same directory.
